description: Smart-Grid Smart-City Electric Vehicle Trial Data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Industry, Science and Resources (DISR). This data is from the Electric Vehicle (EV) trial that was part of the Smart Grid Smart City (SGSC) project. This trial involved a fleet of 20 Mitsubishi iMiEV cars (2010 model) used by households and businesses. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Industry, Science and Resources (DISR). Its tags are EV, Electricity, SGSC, Utilities and Communication, accessories. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, EXCEL (.XLSX). The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
